verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an agentic commerce platform, but the evidence shows no documented bulk or batch operation capability. The surface consists of per-call JSON-RPC tools (search_catalog, create_cart/update_cart, create_checkout, get_order). Multi-line-item carts, a waitlisted Universal Cart, search seeded by a set of product IDs to find similar items, and cursor pagination are adjacent features, not bulk actions across many items, so they earn no credit.
